description: Implementation of rx::FenceNV11 and rx::Sync11 classes for Direct3D 11 fences and synchronization, including helper functions for setting and testing fences, and handling GPU command synchronization.

classes.name: FenceNV11
classes.description: Represents a Direct3D 11 fence object for NVIDIA NV extension, providing methods to set, test, and finish fences.

classes.name: Sync11
classes.description: Implements a synchronization object using Direct3D 11 and Windows performance counters for GPU-CPU synchronization.

methods.name: FenceSetHelper
methods.description: Helper template function to set a fence by creating a query if needed and ending it.

methods.name: FenceTestHelper
methods.description: Helper template function to test if a fence has completed by retrieving query data.

methods.name: FenceNV11::set
methods.description: Sets the fence condition using FenceSetHelper.

methods.name: FenceNV11::test
methods.description: Tests if the fence has been signaled using FenceTestHelper.

methods.name: FenceNV11::finish
methods.description: Blocks until the fence is signaled, polling repeatedly and checking device status.

methods.name: Sync11::set
methods.description: Sets the sync object, similar to FenceSetHelper.

methods.name: Sync11::clientWait
methods.description: Waits for the sync object to be signaled, with timeout handling.

methods.name: Sync11::serverWait
methods.description: Placeholder for server-side wait; currently a no-op.

methods.name: Sync11::getStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of the sync object, returning signaled or unsignaled.
